text: Rayat Al-Tahadi Investment Company also operates under the trade name Offside (OffSide – OffLimits) and specialises in equipping and manufacturing sports clothing.

source.name: Al-Kas sports newspaper – Al-Nahda announces a strategic partnership with Rayat Al-Tahadi Investment Company
source.quote: رعاية رسمية مع راية التحدي للاستثمار المعروفة أيضاً بالاسم التجاري “OffSide – OffLimits” المتخصصة في تجهيز وتصنيع الملابس الرياضية
source.note: Translation of the quote: 'an official sponsorship agreement with Rayat Al-Tahadi Investment, also known by the trade name "OffSide – OffLimits", specialised in equipping and manufacturing sports clothing'.
